name: Claim Rackmore's Treasure!
summary: During Claim Rackmore's Treasure!, Rackmore's log tells of a ship attacked on its way to Feathermoon Stronghold. He hid his treasure chest on Ranazjar Isle to keep it from his enemies, but both keys to open it were lost.

sections.title: A Hidden Chest
sections.body: Rackmore's log tells of seafaring creatures attacking his ship on its way to Feathermoon Stronghold. He hid his treasure chest on Ranazjar Isle to keep it from his enemies. Both keys needed to open it were lost, one silver and one gold. Whoever finds the keys and the chest will find a treasure.

faq.q: Where was Rackmore's ship sailing when it was attacked?
faq.answer: Rackmore's ship was on its way to Feathermoon Stronghold when seafaring creatures attacked it.
Rackmore hid the chest on Ranazjar Isle.

faq.q: What is needed to unlock the chest?
faq.answer: Two keys are needed to open the chest, one silver and one gold. Both were lost.

faq.q: Why did Rackmore hide his treasure?
faq.answer: Rackmore hid the chest on Ranazjar Isle to keep his treasure from his enemies after seafaring creatures attacked his ship.
